description: Utility functions for interacting with Close.com API, including contact management, custom activity types, and lead retrieval, tailored for integration with Cal.com events.

methods.name: getCloseComContactIds
methods.description: Retrieves or creates contacts in Close.com based on provided persons list and optional lead ID.

methods.name: getCustomActivityTypeInstanceData
methods.description: Prepares data for creating a custom activity in Close.com based on a CalendarEvent.

methods.name: getCustomFieldsIds
methods.description: Fetches or creates custom fields in Close.com for specified entity type.

methods.name: getCloseComCustomActivityTypeFieldsIds
methods.description: Ensures the custom activity type and its fields exist in Close.com, creating them if necessary.

methods.name: getCloseComLeadId
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a lead in Close.com based on a company name.
